notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary parameter handle/name lookup across connection, membership, inherited interaction-class definitions, invalid-input, and cross-federate identity boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador API and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM model, endpoint, logical-time choice, and callback configuration. It verifies inherited base-parameter handle stability, derived-parameter lookup, standard name round trips, and standard invalid-name, invalid-class, invalid-parameter, and not-defined exceptions without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador parameter handle/name lookup across lifecycle and inherited interaction-class boundaries
